meaning:
ἀχάριστος, -ον
(χαρίζομαι), [in LXX: Wis.16:29, Sir.29:17, 25, 4Ma.9:10 * ;]
(a) ungracious, unpleasing;
(b) ungrateful, thankless: Luk.6:35, 2Ti.3:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind…
For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
